validity.corpusUnchangedNote: The unchanged-corpus predicate covers what `git status` covers. Git-ignored paths are excluded from the worktree digest per decision 0038 (2026-09-03), because GPK-V0-022 requires repository status before and after each read-only case to be identical and an ignored path never appears in status; the count of excluded paths is recorded as ignoredPaths and never compared. A tracked file its own .gitignore also covers stays covered.
